newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SOCCER-LITHUANIA 0 ROMANIA 1 WORLD CUP QUALIFIER - RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LITHUANIA 0 ROMANIA 1 WORLD CUP QUALIFIER - RESULT.

text.p: Romania beat Lithuania 1-0 (halftime 0-0) in their World Cup European group eight qualifier on Wednesday.

Romania - 23-Bogdan Stelea; 2-Dan Petrescu, 3-Daniel Prodan, 4-Anton Dobos, 5-Konstantin Galca, 6-Gheorghe Popescu, 7-Tibor Selymes, 8-Ion Bladoiu (17-Gheorghe Craioveanu 59), 9-Dinu Moldovan (15-Adrian Ilie 74), 10-Gheorghe Hagi, 11-Dolinel Munteanu

Lithuania - 1-Gintaras Stauce; 2-Tomas Ziukas, 3-Dainius Suliauskas, 4-Andrjeus Tereskinas, 5-Raimondas Veinoras, 6-Raimondas Zutautas, 7-Darius Macilevicius, 8-Valdis Ivanauskas, 9-Aidas Treiksaitis (14-Irmantas Stumbryis 60), 10-Vaidotas Sleikis, 11-Edgaras Jankauskas
